page: Microsoft Azure E48nds_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. Powered by an Intel x86_64 processor, the configuration provides 48 dedicated virtual CPUs and 384.0 GB of system memory, establishing an 8.0 GB per vCPU allocation ratio. The instance features network optimization and does not include hardware accelerators such as GPUs.

For high-speed temporary storage, the instance integrates 2832 GB of local NVMe SSD capacity. It supports Azure Premium Storage for persistent disk integration, enabling split architectures between scratch space and persistent volumes. Public IPv4 connectivity requires manual configuration or association, as zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses are bundled with the base VM provisioning.

With its 1:8 core-to-memory density, dedicated Intel compute resources, and substantial local NVMe storage, the E48nds_v6 is structured for memory-heavy and I/O-intensive workloads. The profile aligns with enterprise relational databases, large in-memory caches, big data processing engines, and transactional ETL pipelines.
description: Microsoft Azure E48nds_v6 is a memory-optimized cloud virtual machine powered by an x86_64 Intel processor on Microsoft Hyper-V. The system provides 48 dedicated virtual CPUs alongside 384.0 GB of RAM, establishing an allocation of 8.0 GB of memory per core. Designed for data-heavy enterprise tasks, the configuration includes 2832 GB of high-speed local NVMe SSD storage and offers support for Premium Storage tiers. As a network-optimized instance lacking dedicated GPU accelerators, it channels its resource capacity entirely toward memory and I/O throughput. The instance provisions zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, operating primarily within private network infrastructures unless additional addressing is configured. Given the dense memory footprint combined with direct NVMe storage, the E48nds_v6 effectively serves demanding database deployments, distributed in-memory data grids, large-scale ETL pipelines, and high-throughput analytics processing environments.
